bagPolicy.summary: SXSW bag policies vary by venue. Attendees are encouraged to travel light; luggage and large cases are not permitted, and larger bags may be inspected. Major Film & TV and Music Festival venues publish their own size/clear-bag limits.
bagPolicy.note: Always check the specific official venue policy before entry.

parking.note: Driving and parking in downtown Austin during SXSW can be expensive and time-consuming due to street closures and increased traffic. It is recommended to use alternative transportation options like walking, shuttles, or rideshares.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive)'s current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability varies across SXSW venues and activations. Check the individual venue or event listing rather than relying on one festival-wide concessions menu.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive), but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive)'s current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive). Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at SXSW (Music, Film & Interactive). Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
